title: A sheafified Koszul coordinate is a scalar mapping cone
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, g:Fin(r+1)->A, i:Fin(r+1), and a in A. On X=Spec(A) [def-pc-scheme], use the category of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let P be the Koszul complex [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex] on the r generators j |-> g(i.succAbove(j)), extended by zero to cochain degrees -q. Let T be termwise associated sheaf, from cochain complexes of A-modules to cochain complexes of O_X-modules. Then the sheafified extended Koszul complex on update(g,i,a) is isomorphic, as a cochain complex, to the mapping cone of T(a times id_P). No derived-category localization, positivity, regularity, or quasi-coherence hypothesis on an auxiliary object is required.

source.place: Tags 0628 and 0629, adjoining the final generator as a scalar cone. Read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0629 (the TeX source is absent locally).

proof.text: Construct the permutation p=(finSuccEquiv last).trans(finSuccEquiv i).symm, so p(last)=i and p(j.castSucc)=i.succAbove(j). Prove contraction naturality under Finsupp.lmapDomain p by CliffordAlgebra.left_induction. Exterior powers of the corresponding linear equivalence are inverse by exteriorPower.map_comp/map_id. Their compatibility with the Koszul boundary yields a complex isomorphism using HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents. Extend its inverse to integer cochain degrees.

Apply exists_koszulTensorConeCoordinates to the reindexed sequence with coefficient module A. Conjugate its linear equivalences by TensorProduct.rid, and prove compatibility with the untensored differentials by tensor-product induction and rid naturality. The resulting coordinates satisfy the separate degree-one and higher differential equations. Apply the generic scalar-cone assembly criterion to these coordinates. Rewrite the prefix as j -> g(i.succAbove j) and the last scalar as a.

Compose the extended reindexing isomorphism with the assembled cone isomorphism and apply the termwise tilde functor. Supply its additive and zero-preserving properties locally using tilde.map_add and tilde.map_zero. Compose with Mathlib CochainComplex.mappingCone.mapHomologicalComplexIso. This is the required sheafified complex isomorphism, with no changed hypothesis or conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0628 and 0629, using explicit generator reindexing, tensor-unit transfer of existing coordinates, the generic cone assembly criterion, and Mathlib additive-functor cone comparison.

lean.statement: theorem koszul_coordinate_cone_iso (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (g : Fin (r + 1) → A) (i : Fin (r + 1)) (a : A) : let T := @Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} A) (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _ (tilde.functor (.of A)) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) let P := (ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A r (fun j ↦ g (i.succAbove j))).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat Nonempty (T.obj ((ExteriorAlgebra.koszulComplex A (r + 1) (Function.update g i a)).extend ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat) ≅ CochainComplex.mappingCone (T.map (a • 𝟙 P)))
